requirements.quote: Find the main-thread work behind the stalls (profile the stall windows: synchronous gh/execFileSync, JSON parsing of large state/log files, fs scans) and move it off the event loop or make it incremental [type:unit]
Under a synthetic load of 4× nproc CPU hogs, `schedd status` answers in < 1 s and dispatch keeps running (test harness) [type:e2e]
Restarting schedd leaves no orphaned child `gh`/schedd processes [type:unit]
Batches that have been "not hosted" for more than N days are reported once and either re-hosted or marked abandoned [type:unit]

deliverables.change: chunked async scans, lag phase log, child kill on close, abandon/re-host once
real-process load harness: spawned daemon, real socket and status CLI, CPU hog processes
document chunking, cache, abandon age, child tracking

preserve.what: schedd status payload shape consumed by bin/engine-cli.mjs scheddFromCli (extra fields only)
lanes outlive the daemon and are re-adopted (bin/lean/schedd.mjs header, bin/lean/schedd.test.mjs)
watchBatches re-host-once-per-ready-set and first-hour report (bin/lean/schedd.mjs, bin/lean/schedd.test.mjs)

regression.covers: sched and host-load neighbours of schedd

decisions.choice: load harness defaults to 2 hogs, `auto` = 4x nproc
decisions.justification: shared host (many lanes); auto reproduces the issue's load on a dedicated host (bin/lean/schedd-load.test.mjs header)

test_plan.proof: a scan over many batch dirs never starves a timer and parses each state once
a spawned daemon answers status over its socket and the real CLI in <1 s under CPU hog processes while its batch keeps writing dispatch rows
test_plan.level_reason: the stall only exists in a real process under real CPU contention
test_plan.reason: load-dependent; harness asserts bound rather than failing deterministically on base

test_plan.proof: in-flight daemon-owned child is killed on close()
unhosted batch idle past N days is abandoned once, or re-hosted when retry pending, and reported once
test_plan.level_reason: watch pass is deterministic with injected clock and dirs
